summary: Short lap of the Magarpatta circle road; the page builds eight longer lines, up to 50 km, from the same start point.

name: Aadrai Jungle
summary: Monsoon forest walk near Khireshwar with streams and waterfalls; the group does it with a local guide.
notes: Long drive for a single day; the source lists it under treks near Pune.

name: Chanderi Fort
summary: Climb to the Chanderi caves, with a harder scree and rock scramble above them to the summit.
trek_time_text: About 3 hours up to the caves
notes: Long drive for a single day; the source lists it under treks near Pune.

evidence.value: About 3 hours up to the caves

name: Devkund Waterfall
summary: Mostly flat forest walk from Bhira to a plunge pool under a tall waterfall near Tamhini ghat. Swimming is not allowed, per the guide.
notes: Guide gives the walk as about 9-10 km there and back; left out of distance_km because it is a range.

name: Ghoradeshwar
summary: Short morning hill and cave hike off the old Mumbai-Pune highway near Talegaon; exposed, so the guide suggests an early start.
start_point: Ghorawadi, near Somatane on the old Mumbai–Pune highway

evidence.value: Ghorawadi, near Somatane on the old Mumbai–Pune highway

name: Harishchandragad
summary: Long Sahyadri trek to Konkan Kada and the Kedareshwar cave, approached from Pachnai or Khireshwar.
start_point: Pachnai (Akole side, shortest) or Khireshwar (Malshej side)
notes: Long drive for a single day; the source lists it under treks near Pune.

evidence.value: Pachnai (Akole side, shortest) or Khireshwar (Malshej side)

name: Jivdhan Fort
summary: Fort above the old Naneghat pass with rock-cut steps, rock patches and the Vanarlingi pinnacle.
notes: Long drive for a single day; the source lists it under treks near Pune.

name: Kalavantin Durg & Prabalgad
summary: Pinnacle near Panvel reached by steep rock-cut steps without railings, beside the forested Prabalgad plateau.
trek_time_text: 1.5–2 hours to Prabal Machi, then about 1 hour to the top of Kalavantin

evidence.value: 1.5–2 hours to Prabal Machi, then about 1 hour to the top of Kalavantin

name: Kalsubai Peak
summary: Long steady climb from Bari with iron ladders near the top; the guide gives the summit as 1,646 m, Maharashtra's highest point.
notes: Long drive for a single day; the source lists it under treks near Pune.

name: Kalu Waterfall
summary: Forest trek near Khireshwar to a tall waterfall below Harishchandragad.
notes: Long drive for a single day; the source lists it under treks near Pune.

name: Katraj to Sinhagad (K2S)
summary: Ridge traverse of about 13 km over a dozen hills from Katraj ghat to Sinhagad, often done at night.
notes: Start is about 12 km from central Pune per the guide; no road travel time is stated because the trek starts in the city. Unlit ridge, often walked at night.

name: Lohagad Fort
summary: Short climb on stone steps from Lohagadwadi through four gateways, or a longer walk from Malavli station; a common first fort.

name: Rajgad Fort
summary: Long climb to Padmavati Machi on Shivaji Maharaj's first capital, with three large spurs to explore on top.

name: Ratangad Fort
summary: Forest climb from Ratanwadi with ladders, caves on top and a natural rock window called Nedhe.
notes: Long drive for a single day; the source lists it under treks near Pune.

name: Rohida Fort
summary: Short, quiet fort above Bhor with carved gateways and cisterns; also called Vichitragad.

name: Sinhagad Fort
summary: Steady, rocky climb of about 2.7 km from Atkarwadi; a ghat road also reaches most of the way up.
start_point: Atkarwadi (Sinhagad paytha), or Kalyan village for the steeper route
notes: distance_km is the one-way path from Atkarwadi, as stated by the guide.

evidence.value: Atkarwadi (Sinhagad paytha), or Kalyan village for the steeper route

name: Sudhagad Fort
summary: Forested fort near Pali with ladders, a wide plateau and an old wada on top.

name: Torna Fort
summary: Long, steep climb from Velhe along rocky ridges; the guide advises against it as a first trek.

name: Tung Fort
summary: Short, steep cone above Pawna lake with an exposed final climb.
trek_time_text: 45 minutes to 1 hour up from Tungwadi

evidence.value: 45 minutes to 1 hour up from Tungwadi

name: Visapur Fort
summary: Larger, quieter neighbour of Lohagad with a big plateau; in monsoon, streams run down the old steps.

name: Khadakwasla Dam
summary: Dam on the Mutha river south-west of the city, listed by the district as a scenic spot reachable by city bus.
notes: District page says about 15 km from Pune city (its summary says 20 km), with buses from Swargate, Pune station and Shivajinagar. Travel time not stated, so the DAY_TRIP label is incomplete.
